summary_zh: 泰國商務部要求製造商維持售價，罐頭魚等品項面臨漲價壓力，能源運輸成本問題持續。羅勇府查獲逾千噸非法電子廢棄物，環保稽查趨嚴。另Betagro加速拓展寵物食品OEM出口至美國與印度，9月通訊設備產值因數據中心需求增長50%，出口與市場開發成為新焦點。
summary_en: Thailand's Commerce Ministry asked makers to hold prices as canned fish faces cost pressure. Over 1,000 tons of illegal e-waste were seized in Rayong. Betagro is expanding pet-food OEM exports to the US and India, and September communications equipment output rose 50% on data center demand.
